note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 Army Equipment Support Publication AESP 2350-P-100-201, Challenger Tank Automotive System (June 1983, held copy at Amendment 8 of October 1988). It holds the Challenger 1 as a tracked entry. The document page header reads 2350-P-100-201 while the mirror file name reads 230-P-100-201; both are recorded. The scan has no text layer, so the figures were read from a rendered image and are quoted from the OCR of printed pages xii to xiv. It publishes the combat loaded weight, the gun-forward overall length, the overall width, the height to the commander's sight hood, the nominal ground clearance, the shallow fording depth, the nominal maximum road speed, the maximum gradient, the track width, the number of links per track, the engine model with its gross rating, the automatic gearbox class and the four forward gear count. It publishes no track pitch, no net power with a stated basis and no explicit grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready. The document names the vehicle Challenger; the catalogue records the Challenger 1 because the publication is the June 1983 Challenger automotive manual and it is not the Challenger 2.

operating_weight_kg.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 17 Weights, Combat loaded row
operating_weight_kg.state: combat loaded weight including ammunition, fuel and CES items and crew stowage but not crew, published as 62 tonne (61 ton); recorded as 62,000 kg with the tonne taken as 1,000 kg; the manual publishes the training weight as 60.9 tonne (59.9 ton) on the same page as a separate configuration

length_mm.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 19 Dimensions, Length overall, gun forward row
length_mm.state: overall length gun forward, published as 11,560 mm (37 ft 10 in); the manual publishes 9,800 mm (32 ft 2 in) for gun in crutch as a separate configuration

width_mm.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 19 Dimensions, Width overall row
width_mm.state: overall width, published as 3,510 mm (11 ft 6 in); the published millimetre figure used directly

height_mm.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 19 Dimensions, Height to top of commander's sight hood row
height_mm.state: height to the top of the commander's sight hood, published as 2,950 mm (9 ft 8 in); the manual publishes no height to the turret roof

ground_clearance_mm.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 19 Dimensions, Ground clearance (nominal) row
ground_clearance_mm.state: nominal ground clearance, published as 500 mm (1 ft 8 in); the manual labels the figure nominal

fording_depth_mm.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 20 Performance, Shallow fording row
fording_depth_mm.state: shallow fording, published as 1.07 m (3 ft 6 in); the manual publishes no deep-fording figure

max_speed_kmh.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 20 Performance, Maximum road speed row
max_speed_kmh.state: nominal maximum road speed, published as 56 km/h (35 mile/h); the manual labels the figure nominal

max_gradient_deg.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 20 Performance, Maximum gradient row
max_gradient_deg.state: maximum gradient, published as 58 percent (30 degrees), vehicle moving; the manual publishes both figures and the degree figure is recorded

track_shoe_width_mm.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 22 Tracks, Track width row
track_shoe_width_mm.state: track width, published as 650 mm (25.6 in); the published millimetre figure used directly

track_shoe_count.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiii, section 22 Tracks, Number of links row
track_shoe_count.state: number of links, published as 92 per track; the published count used directly

engine_model.value: Rolls Royce CV 12 TCA 1200, No 3, Mk 4A
engine_model.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiv, section 23 Power pack, Main engine row
engine_model.state: twelve-cylinder 60-degree Vee four-stroke compression ignition engine, published as CV12 TCA 1200 No 3 Mk 4A with two turbochargers, charge air coolers and an inlet manifold heater

published_power_hp.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiv, section 23 Power pack, Rating (gross) row
published_power_hp.state: rating (gross) published as 1,200 BHP (895 kW) at 2,300 rev/min; the manual labels the rating gross, not net

transmission_type.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xii, paragraph 14; printed page xiv, section 25 Gearbox
transmission_type.state: automatic gearbox, published as an automatic gearbox with four forward and three reverse speeds; the page xiv data names the gearbox TN 37 No 1 Mk 3 epicyclic

gears.locator: Vehicle introduction and data, printed page xiv, section 25 Gearbox
gears.state: four forward gears and three reverse gears, published for the TN 37 No 1 Mk 3 epicyclic gearbox
